goal: Allow flow node retry limits to resolve from either scalar or mode-specific maxAttempts values, with draft review using a lower auto-mode retry budget while scalar nodes keep their current behavior.

analysis.problem: Review nodes currently expose a single fixed maxAttempts value. That makes draft review in auto mode use the same retry budget as manual mode even though auto retries are self-correction loops by the same agent, while manual retries include user judgment.
analysis.proposedApproach: Allow maxAttempts to be either a scalar positive integer or a mode-specific object with positive integer auto and manual keys. Scalar values are used as-is for any node; mode-specific values resolve from flow.autoApprove. Public next-action and retry consumers receive the resolved numeric value. Configure review-draft as { auto: 1, manual: 5 }, review-spec as { auto: 3, manual: 3 }, and review-test as { auto: 3, manual: 3 }. Leave gate nodes and implementation review scalar so their retry budgets do not change. Specify that only draft review exhaustion stops without an extra confirmation prompt.
analysis.validation: The approach addresses the root problem by reducing draft auto self-correction to one attempt while preserving manual draft review flexibility. It preserves existing scalar limits for nodes that do not opt into mode-specific behavior, keeps public retry contracts numeric, and limits the added no-confirmation exhaustion behavior to review-draft as requested.

in: must: FlowNode.maxAttempts accepts scalar positive integers and mode-specific { auto, manual } positive-integer values.
must: Scalar maxAttempts values are used directly for any node, including review nodes configured with a number.
must: Mode-specific maxAttempts values require both auto and manual positive-integer keys and resolve by flow.autoApprove.
must: Public next-action and retry consumers receive a resolved numeric maxAttempts value for the current mode.
must: Initial mode-specific settings: review-draft { auto: 1, manual: 5 }, review-spec { auto: 3, manual: 3 }, review-test { auto: 3, manual: 3 }.
must: Propagation of autoApprove into maxAttempts consumers that build next-action envelopes or enforce retry limits.
must: review-draft behavior when the maxAttempts limit is reached: no additional approval/confirmation options are presented.
should: Unit coverage for scalar and mode-specific maxAttempts resolution and invalid values.
out: Changing gate retry limits; gate nodes stay scalar.
Changing implementation code review retry limits; implementation review stays scalar.
Applying the no-additional-confirmation exhaustion rule to review-spec or review-test.

impactOnExisting: Manual draft review can run up to five attempts instead of the current fixed three.
Auto draft review stops after one attempt instead of using the current fixed three.
Spec review and test review keep an effective limit of three attempts in both modes while using the new object form.
Nodes that keep scalar maxAttempts, including gate nodes and implementation review, retain their existing retry budgets.
Existing consumers of next-action maxAttempts continue to see a number rather than a raw mode-specific object.

qa.question: draft review 上限到達時の仕様はこれで確定しますか？
qa.answer: はい。review-draft は maxAttempts 到達時に停止するが、追加のユーザー確認は出さない。step は done にしない。承認・確認の選択肢は PASS 後だけ表示する。この追加確認なし要件は review-draft のみに適用し、review-spec / review-test には広げない。
qa.evidence: src/flow/prompts/plan/review-draft.md defines maxAttempts reached as STOP and Do not set step done, and places the approval choice under Approval (after verdict=PASS). src/flow/commands/review.js runDraftReview only writes draft-review.md and prints PASS/FAIL. User selected review-draft only for no-additional-confirmation on 2026-05-01.
qa.why: This preserves the existing exhaustion stop, defines the observable control-flow boundary, and limits the added UI requirement to the phase the user confirmed.
qa.considered: Advancing to the next step after exhaustion was rejected because unresolved draft review issues would be bypassed. Applying the no-confirmation rule to review-spec/review-test was offered and not selected.

qa.question: maxAttempts の形式・値 invariant・解決規則はどうしますか？
qa.answer: maxAttempts は positive integer または { auto: positive integer, manual: positive integer }。number は全 mode でその値を使う。object は flow.autoApprove=true なら auto、false または未設定なら manual を使う。object で auto/manual の片方が欠ける値、0、負数、float、NaN、非 number は FlowNode 構築時に不正とする。
qa.evidence: src/flow/definition.js currently constructs FlowNode instances and stores maxAttempts; project rules require meaningful value invariants to be represented by classes and constructor invariants.
qa.why: Attempts are loop limits, so positive integers are the only meaningful values. Resolving missing autoApprove as manual preserves the existing default mode where autoApprove is absent or false.
qa.considered: Allowing partial objects or non-positive values was rejected because it would make retry behavior ambiguous or non-terminating.

qa.question: mode 別値を設定する review node と値はどうしますか？
qa.answer: review-draft: { auto: 1, manual: 5 }; review-spec: { auto: 3, manual: 3 }; review-test: { auto: 3, manual: 3 }. Implementation code review remains scalar 3.
qa.evidence: User specified the three plan review values in the review-draft follow-up on 2026-05-01; src/flow/definition.js currently has review-draft, review-spec, review-test via createPlanReviewNode and implementation review as a separate review node.
qa.why: This targets the draft auto-loop problem while keeping spec/test effective limits unchanged at three in both modes. Implementation review is outside the requested plan review configuration.
qa.considered: Applying mode-specific values to implementation review was offered but not selected.

qa.question: downstream consumers receive raw maxAttempts or resolved maxAttempts?
qa.answer: Consumers receive a resolved numeric maxAttempts for the current mode. The internal definition may store the mode-specific object, but next-action envelopes, review retry loops, and gate retry resolution use a number.
qa.evidence: deriveNextAction currently returns maxAttempts to next-action envelope builders, and review/gate code consumes maxAttempts as retry counts. Keeping that boundary numeric preserves the existing consumer contract.
qa.why: This hides mode-resolution details behind the flow definition layer and prevents downstream code from branching on raw object shape.
qa.considered: Exposing the raw object in envelopes was rejected because it would force all consumers and schemas to understand both representations.

qa.question: 既存の scalar gate limit は変更しますか？
qa.answer: 変更しない。gate-draft, gate, gate-impl は number のまま既存値を使う。
qa.evidence: src/flow/definition.js currently defines gate-draft maxAttempts 10, gate maxAttempts 20, and gate-impl maxAttempts 5; draft scope excludes changing gate retry limits.
qa.why: The issue concerns review retry behavior. Keeping gate nodes scalar avoids unrelated behavior changes while still allowing the shared resolver API to handle scalar values consistently.
qa.considered: Making all gate nodes mode-specific was rejected as outside the Issue #307 concern.

approval.notes: manual approval; updated during review-draft to address review gaps
